sourceNote: VSTAR Universe (JP): Japanese Pokémon model, confidence LOW — a scaffold, not a measured study. Catalog + card images from TCGdex (Japanese names), card + box prices from PriceCharting's 'Pokemon Japanese <set>' consoles. TCGdex does not carry rarities for the JP secret/chase range (#166+ come back null), so the chase tier here is INFERRED from market value — the priced holos that aren't base-set rares are grouped as ultra_rare, and the ultra-chases (SAR/UR > $100) are shown display-only, out of EV, exactly as the Chinese gem-pack model does. Per-pack odds reuse the English-era shape at deliberately conservative rates (understating, the safe direction), so ROI reads as an honest lower bound, not a promise. Tier values are live PriceCharting prices.
